''Roblox Winter Spotlight''
17 December 2024 – 2 January 2025 |pass_dates = 16 December 2024 – 12 February 2025 |tracks = 2 |part_of = Roblox's [[w:c:roblox:Winter Spotlight|Winter Spotlight]] |previous_event = [[Tower Defense Simulator x PLS DONATE Event|Tower Defense Simulator x PLS DONATE]] |next_event = [[The Hunt: Mega Edition Event|The Hunt: Mega Edition]] |previous_pass = [[Hexscape Event#Hexscape Event Battle Pass|Hexscape]] |next_pass = [[Ducky Revenge Event#Ducky Revenge Battle Pass|Ducky Revenge]] }} {{ScrollTOC|400px}} ==Description== '''Operation I.C.E Event''' was the nineteenth event to be added in Tower Defense Simulator. It brought two new towers and a battle pass, which required {{Bell|Bells}} to reach higher levels. This event featured a unique map with mostly returning enemies from the [[Frost Invasion Event]] and [[Krampus' Revenge Event]], along with a unique wave structure. This event also had two difficulties: Easy and Hard. The event started on the 16th of December 2024 at 22:00 UTC and ended on the 15th of January 2025 at 20:00 UTC. ==Operation I.C.E Battle Pass== [[File:Operation I.C.E Battle Pass.png|center|thumb|450x450px]] Bells were the currency used for the '''Operation I.C.E Battle Pass''', which dropped from enemies upon death. Enemies dropped between one and three {{Bell|Bells}}, and they could have been collected by walking near them. The number of {{Bell|Bells}} obtained from currency drops varied based on the mode played. {| class="tds-table pad-10" style="text-align:center; margin:0 auto;" !Mode !Bells per Wave !Total Bells |- |'''Outpost 32 (Easy)''' |{{Bell|10}} |{{Bell|250}} |- |'''Outpost 32 (Hard)''' |{{Bell|23}} |{{Bell|920}} |- |'''Easy''' |{{Bell|5}} |{{Bell|125}} |- |'''Casual''' |{{Bell|8}} |{{Bell|240}} |- |'''Intermediate''' |{{Bell|10}} |{{Bell|300}} |- |'''Molten''' |{{Bell|10}} |{{Bell|350}} |- |'''Fallen & Challenge Maps''' |{{Bell|14}} |{{Bell|560}} |- |'''Special Maps''' |{{Bell|1}} |{{Bell|40}} |} While the battle pass did have a set amount for [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode, that being {{Bell|800}} which when divided by total waves made it give {{Bell|16}}, this did not work and [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode instead gave nothing. In total, it took {{Bell|27,080}} or {{Robux|5,030}} to complete the battle pass. It had two tracks, the regular track obtained for free and a premium track purchasable for {{Robux|499}}. During the Winter 2024 Holiday Sale, it was obtainable for {{Robux|374}}. Certain items like [[High Grade Crate]]s are given out multiple times. In total, the '''Operation I.C.E Battle Pass''' gives out {{Coins|2,300}}, {{Exp|1,225}}, {{TimeScaleTicket|8}}, 6 [[High Grade Crate]]s, 2 [[Premium Crate]]s, 22 [[Holiday Crate]]s and
